result.notes: Documentary manufacturing audit completed against the three supplied excerpts. The evidence supports board-level routing/DFM status and external socket pad geometry, but it does not qualify the fab process, assembly, QS30-1/GZC13-F socket hardware, harness, insulation, or voltage/fault behavior. Mechanical assembly remains HOLD; remaining unknowns and next-gate evidence are enumerated in the inventory. No issue blocking this documentary review was found in the supplied evidence.
